info.title: AI Presentations API
info.description:
REST API for AI Presentations — an AI-powered presentation platform with narrated slides, live Q&A, and deck management.

**Authentication**: Most endpoints require a session cookie obtained from `POST /api/auth/login`. Presentation playback endpoints (`/api/qa`, `/api/narration/*`) also accept a `presentationId` for unauthenticated viewer access.

deckContext.description: Background info used to guide AI narration generation

previewImageUrl.description: Presigned URL for the first slide image

previewImageThumbUrl.description: Presigned URL for the first slide thumbnail rendition (the full image when no thumbnail exists)

generation.description: The latest unsettled generation job (pending, processing, or failed); null once it completed or if the deck was never generated

audio_url.description: S3 key for the slide audio file

hero_img.description: S3 key for the slide image

hero_img_thumb.description: Presigned URL for the thumbnail rendition (the full image URL when no thumbnail exists). Deck read endpoints only — omitted from slide create/update responses

avatar.description: S3 key for rep avatar image

audioUrl.description: S3 key for the pre-generated answer audio

resumePromptText.description: Spoken prompt asking if the viewer wants to continue the presentation

transitionPromptText.description: Spoken bridge from Q&A back into the presentation

audioUrl.description: Accessible URL for the synthesized audio
Accessible URL for the TTS audio of the answer

GenerationStatus.description: A deck generation job. The single-job endpoint (`GET /api/decks/{deckId}/generate/status`) adds the row counts and timestamps; the deck list and the per-organization poll carry only the fields common to both.

currentSlide.description: The slide that most recently STARTED processing; completed work is currentSlide − 1

totalSlides.description: 0 until the job flips to processing

progress.description: 0-100, derived from completed slides / totalSlides; 100 once settled

slidesCreated.description: Slide rows that exist for the deck right now. This is the signal to refresh on: currentSlide marks a slide's start, and the row lands a full slide's work later. Single-job endpoint only.

faqsCreated.description: FAQ rows that exist right now. The job tracks no FAQ state; they are written in one batch after the last slide. Single-job endpoint only.

get.description: Returns all decks for the authenticated organization, ordered by most recently created.

deckContext.description: Background information to guide AI narration generation (e.g. audience, purpose)

get.summary: Poll generation status for every deck
get.description: The latest unsettled generation job for every deck in the organization, keyed by deck id. Completed jobs are omitted, so a deck absent from the map has nothing running. Cheap enough to poll while a template is being built — unlike `GET /api/decks`, it carries no preview URLs.

200.description: Unsettled jobs keyed by deck id

get.description: Returns the full deck including slides, FAQs, branding, and Q&A settings.

generation.description: The latest unsettled generation job; null once it completed or if the deck was never generated

delete.description: Permanently deletes a deck and all associated slides, FAQs, and branding.

slideIds.description: Full ordered array of slide UUIDs. Position in array becomes the new orderIndex.

post.description: Creates a FAQ and automatically generates TTS audio for the answer.

warning.description: Present if audio generation failed (FAQ is still saved)

200.description: Branding configuration, or null if not yet set

put.description: Creates or replaces the branding configuration for a deck.

avatar.description: S3 key for rep avatar image

get.description: Returns the customizable resume and transition prompts for the deck's Q&A experience.

post.description: Accepts uploaded slide images, runs them through GPT-4o Vision to extract content, generates narration scripts, and synthesizes audio. Returns a job ID — poll `/api/decks/{deckId}/generate/status` for progress.

images.description: Slide images (PNG, JPG, or WebP; max 10 MB each)

get.description: Returns all non-deleted presentations created from this deck.

post.description: Creates a personalized presentation. Provide `homeowner`, `prospect_id`, or both — at least one is required. With only `homeowner`, a Core prospect is created from it. With only `prospect_id`, homeowner data is fetched from that prospect's Core journey. With both, the supplied homeowner data is used as-is and the existing prospect is attached (it must be visible to your credential — otherwise 422 PROSPECT_NOT_FOUND). The address is validated via Google Geocoding. Returns a shareable URL immediately; audio generation may continue in the background. While the deck itself is still being generated the request is refused with 409 DECK_GENERATING — a snapshot taken then would be permanently short slides — and should be retried once the job settles.

prospect_id.description: Core prospect to attach the presentation to. Alone, homeowner data is fetched from the prospect's journey; with `homeowner`, the prospect is attached and the supplied data is used as-is. Must be visible to your credential.

price_inputs.description: Values for deck-level price variables (used to evaluate formulas)

409.description: Conflict: `DECK_GENERATING` — the deck is still being generated. Transient; retry once the job settles.

422.description: Unprocessable: `INVALID_ADDRESS` (address could not be verified), `PROSPECT_NOT_FOUND` (prospect_id does not exist or belongs to another organization — permanent, do not retry), or `PROSPECT_CREATE_FAILED` (Core rejected the prospect data)

patch.description: Partial update for homeowner data, voice settings, language, or price inputs.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a presentation (sets `deletedAt`). The shareable URL stops working immediately.

get.description: Returns the current processing status and slide readiness.

post.description:
Answers a viewer question. Checks FAQs first (exact then semantic match at ≥ 0.6 confidence), falls back to GPT-4o with slide context. Returns answer text plus synthesized audio.

**Authentication**: Accepts either a session cookie (admin) or a `presentationId` (public viewer).
Generates TTS audio for a slide script. Results are cached per session.
Batch TTS generation. Per-slide failures return a fallback audio URL rather than failing the whole batch.
Generates the spoken bridge from Q&A back into the presentation, using the deck's configured transition prompt.

get.description: Returns all uploaded images for the authenticated organization.

post.description: Uploads and optimizes an image (Sharp: max 1920px width; JPEG quality 85, or WebP quality 80 when format=webp). Returns the S3 key and a presigned URL.

file.description: Image file (PNG, JPG, or WebP; max 10 MB)

format.description: Opt into WebP output, for slide imagery. Omit for anything that may be embedded in an email — Outlook desktop cannot render WebP. Default output is JPEG, or PNG when the source has transparency.

delete.description: Permanently removes the image, its thumbnail rendition and its database row. Refused with 409 while any deck or presentation still references the key; clear the reference first.

409.description: Image is still in use; nothing was deleted

get.description: Returns a curated list of ElevenLabs voices suitable for sales presentations.
Returns `{ ok: true }` if the service is running.
